description: DELETE /v2/functions/namespaces/{namespace_id} answers 409 `conflict updating user doc with removed namespace: conflict` when another namespace of the same team is deleted at the same moment; the same delete succeeds when retried. Type it as NamespaceDeleteConflict so a delete can retry it.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Another change to the team's namespaces raced this delete (409 `conflict updating user doc with removed namespace`). Retry it.
